presentationProfile.title: ManyReach
presentationProfile.description: Manyreach helps teams run cold email campaigns and manage leads, inboxes, and replies

Api2Account_GetAccount.description: Returns account details and API context for the authenticated account.

Api2Account_GetCredits.description: Returns the account sending-credit balance and status.

Api2Account_GetDataTokens.description: Returns data-token status for the account.

Api2Blacklist_AddDomains.description: Adds one or more domains to the account blacklist.

Api2Blacklist_AddEmails.description: Adds one or more email addresses to the account blacklist.

Api2Blacklist_CheckDomain.displayName: Check whether a domain is blacklisted
Api2Blacklist_CheckDomain.description: Checks whether a domain is on the account blacklist.

Api2Blacklist_CheckEmail.displayName: Check whether an email is blacklisted
Api2Blacklist_CheckEmail.description: Checks whether an email address is on the account blacklist.

Api2Blacklist_DeleteDomainById.description: Removes a domain blacklist entry by its block ID.

Api2Blacklist_DeleteEmailById.description: Removes an email blacklist entry by its block ID.

Api2Blacklist_GetDomains.description: Lists domains on the account blacklist.

Api2Blacklist_GetEmails.description: Lists email addresses on the account blacklist.

Api2Clientspace_AllocateClientspaceCredi.description: Moves credits from the parent agency to a clientspace with separate credits. Use externalReference to make retries idempotent.

Api2Clientspace_CreateClientspace.description: Creates a new clientspace under the authenticated parent organization (agency).

Api2Clientspace_DeleteClientspace.description: Deletes a clientspace under the authenticated parent organization (agency).

Api2Clientspace_GetAllClientspace.description: Retrieves all clientspaces under the authenticated parent organization (agency).

Api2Clientspace_GetClientspaceById.description: Retrieves details of a specific clientspace by its OrganizationID.

Api2Clientspace_GetClientspaceCredits.description: Returns the clientspace balance and credit mode. Shared mode reflects its monthly allocation when enabled, or the parent agency balance otherwise.

Api2Clientspace_UpdateClientspacev2.description: Updates one or more clientspace fields (Title, Credit Limit, Separate Credits) under the authenticated organization.

Api2Message_GetMessagesByType.description: Lists messages by required type with filters and cursor or offset pagination. Message body text is truncated to 500 characters.

Api2Message_Reply.description: Replies to a received email with optional personalization, CC/BCC, sender override, quoted original, and campaign tracking.

Api2Order_AllocateOrderItemNameserversAs.description: Gets the registrar nameservers for an ExistingDomain item. The call is idempotent; after updating DNS, verify the records.

Api2Order_CreateOrder.description: Returns the current mailbox draft order or creates one if none exists.

Api2Order_CreateOrderCheckoutAsync.description: Starts hosted checkout for a draft order with at least three mailboxes. A prior unpaid session is cancelled; the order stays draft until payment is confirmed.

Api2Order_CreateOrderItem.description: Adds a domain, existing domain, or mailbox to a draft order. Any unpaid checkout session is cancelled.

Api2Order_DeleteOrderItem.description: Removes an item from a draft order and cancels any unpaid checkout session. A domain with attached mailboxes cannot be removed.

Api2Order_GetDraftOrder.description: Returns the current mailbox draft order for the organization together with its line items.

Api2Order_GetOrderById.description: Returns one order, including its line items and their per-item provisioning state.

Api2Order_GetOrderItems.description: Returns the line items on an order, paginated.

Api2Order_GetOrders.description: Lists orders newest first. Draft orders are available through GET /api/v2/orders/draft.

Api2Order_UpdateOrder.description: Updates a draft order’s subtype, forwarding domain, or registrant. A subtype change reprices the order and cancels an unpaid checkout; other changes do not.

Api2Order_UpdateOrderItem.description: Updates an order item’s title or description on a draft order and cancels any unpaid checkout session.

Api2Order_VerifyOrderItemNameserversAsyn.description: After checkout, checks DNS for ExistingDomain or ReusedDomain items. Mismatches stay pending; completed orders and transient lookup errors do not change state.

Api2Tag_CreateTag.description: Creates a new tag for the authenticated organization.

Api2Tag_DeleteTag.description: Deletes a tag from the organization.

Api2Tag_GetTagById.displayName: Gets a single tag by ID
Api2Tag_GetTagById.description: Retrieves details of a specific tag.

Api2Tag_GetTagCampaigns.displayName: Gets all campaigns that have this tag
Api2Tag_GetTagCampaigns.description: Retrieves a paginated list of campaigns with the specified tag.

Api2Tag_GetTagProspects.displayName: Gets all prospects that have this tag
Api2Tag_GetTagProspects.description: Retrieves a paginated list of prospects with the specified tag.

Api2Tag_GetTagSenders.displayName: Gets all senders that have this tag
Api2Tag_GetTagSenders.description: Retrieves a paginated list of senders with the specified tag.

Api2Tag_GetTags.description: Retrieves all tags for the authenticated organization with optional filters.

Api2Tag_UpdateTag.displayName: Updates an existing tag's title and description
Api2Tag_UpdateTag.description: Updates the title and description of an existing tag.

Api2User_CreateUserAsync.description: Registers a new user account or edits existing based on guid.

Api2User_DeleteUser.description: Deletes a user from the organization by GUID.

Api2User_GetUserByID.description: Retrieves a specific user's details by GUID for the authenticated organization.

Api2User_GetUsers.description: Retrieves all users for the authenticated organization with pagination support.

Api2User_UpdateUser.description: Updates one or more fields of an existing user for the authenticated organization.

Api2Validation_GetBatchStatus.description: Returns the current processing status and results for a validation batch.

Api2Validation_SubmitEmails.description: Queues email validation. Unknown addresses are first created as prospects; results appear after processing completes.

Api2Whitelabel_UpdateWhiteLabelSetting.description: Updates whitelabel-related appearance and domain settings for the authenticated organization.

Api2Workspace_AllocateWorkspaceCredits.description: Moves credits from the main account to a workspace with separate credits. Use externalReference to make retries idempotent.

Api2Workspace_CreateWorkspace.description: Creates a new workspace (subaccount) under the calling agency org.

Api2Workspace_DeleteWorkspace.description: Deletes a workspace (subaccount) for the parent agency org.

Api2Workspace_GetAllWorkspace.description: Retrieves all workspaces (subaccounts) for the authenticated agency organization.

Api2Workspace_GetWorkspaceById.description: Retrieves a specific workspace by id, if owned by the caller's organization.

Api2Workspace_GetWorkspaceCredits.description: Returns the workspace balance and credit mode. Shared mode reflects its monthly allocation when enabled, or the main account balance otherwise.

Api2Workspace_UpdateWorkspace.description: Updates the title of a workspace (organization) for agency-owned orgs.

ApiCampaign_AddCampaignTags.displayName: Add a single tag to a campaign
ApiCampaign_AddCampaignTags.description: Adds a tag to the specified campaign.

ApiCampaign_CopyCampaign.description: Makes a copy of a campaign, including settings, sequences, and follow-ups. Prospect enrolment is not copied; the new campaign starts with 0 prospects.

ApiCampaign_CreateCampaignAsync.description: Creates a new campaign associated with the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_CreateSequence.description: Creates a new sequence for a specific campaign owned by the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_DeleteCampaign.description: Deletes a campaign by ID for the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaignByID.description: Retrieves campaign details by campaign ID for the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaignProspect.description: Returns a prospect’s campaign enrollment and status, which may differ from the prospect’s global status.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaignProspects.description: Lists campaign enrollments and their campaign-level status. Cursor pagination uses enrollment IDs; a deleted prospect may be null.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaignSequences.description: Fetches all sequences for a given campaign ID owned by the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaignStats.description: Returns campaign statistics for a date range, defaulting from campaign creation to now. Set refresh=true to recalculate the results.

ApiCampaign_GetCampaigns.description: Lists campaigns by name in descending order with offset or cursor pagination. Archived campaigns are excluded unless include_archived is enabled.

ApiCampaign_PauseCampaignAsync.description: Pauses an active campaign to temporarily stop sending messages

ApiCampaign_RemoveCampaignTags.displayName: Remove a specific tag from a campaign
ApiCampaign_RemoveCampaignTags.description: Removes a tag from the specified campaign.

ApiCampaign_RemoveProspectFromCampaign.description: Deletes a prospect by ID for the authenticated organization.

ApiCampaign_StartCampaignAsync.description: Initiates a campaign to begin sending messages to its target audience

ApiCampaign_UnarchiveCampaignAsync.displayName: Restore an archived campaign to draft.
ApiCampaign_UnarchiveCampaignAsync.description: Restores an archived campaign to draft state.

ApiCampaign_UpdateCampaign.description: Updates only supplied fields for a single campaign by ID.

ApiCampaign_UpdateCampaignProspect.description: Updates a prospect’s status or sending activity within a campaign. System statuses are read-only; reactivation makes it eligible for the next send window.

ApiFollowup_DeleteFollowup.description: Deletes (soft delete) a follow-up email for a campaign/sequence owned by the authenticated organization.

ApiFollowup_GetFollowup.description: Retrieves the full details for a single follow-up in a campaign sequence, for the authenticated org.

ApiFollowup_UpdateFollowup.description: Updates supplied fields for a follow-up email in a campaign sequence belonging to the authenticated org.

ApiList_CreateList.description: Creates a new list for the authenticated organization.

ApiList_DeleteList.description: Deletes a list; memberships block deletion by default. force=true removes memberships but keeps prospects. Over 10,000 memberships block force deletion.

ApiList_GetListById.displayName: Retrieves a specific mailing list by ID
ApiList_GetListById.description: Returns details of a single mailing list for the authenticated organization.

ApiList_GetLists.description: Returns all mailing lists for the authenticated organization.

ApiList_RemoveListProspect.displayName: Remove a specific prospect from a list
ApiList_RemoveListProspect.description: Removes a prospect from the specified list without deleting the prospect.

ApiList_UpdateList.description: Updates the supplied fields on a prospect list.

ApiProspect_AddProspectTags.displayName: Add a single tag to a prospect
ApiProspect_AddProspectTags.description: Adds a tag to the specified prospect.

ApiProspect_AddProspectsBulkAsync.displayName: Bulk add prospects to a list or campaign
ApiProspect_AddProspectsBulkAsync.description: Creates or updates prospects by email and can add them to a list or campaign. Omitted or null fields keep saved values; existing prospects retain createdAt.

ApiProspect_CreateProspect.description: Creates a single prospect in the CRM.

ApiProspect_DeleteProspect.description: Deletes a prospect from the system.

ApiProspect_GetProspectById.description: Retrieves a specific prospect by its ID. Supports optional includes via `?include=campaignIds,listIds,tagIds` parameter.

ApiProspect_GetProspectMessages.displayName: Get message history for a prospect
ApiProspect_GetProspectMessages.description:
Returns paginated message history for a prospect using DateTime-based cursor pagination.
Messages are ordered by time chronologically.

ApiProspect_GetProspectTags.displayName: Get all tags for a prospect
ApiProspect_GetProspectTags.description: Lists tags assigned to the specified prospect.

ApiProspect_GetProspects.description: Returns prospects for the authenticated organization with optional filters. Supports email-to-ID lookup via `?email=` parameter.

ApiProspect_RemoveProspectTags.displayName: Remove a specific tag from a prospect
ApiProspect_RemoveProspectTags.description: Removes a tag from the specified prospect.

ApiProspect_UpdateProspect.description: Updates specified fields of a prospect. Only provided fields are updated. Replaces the deprecated /status/patch endpoint.

ApiSender_AddSenderTagsAsync.displayName: Add a single tag to a sender
ApiSender_AddSenderTagsAsync.description: Adds a tag to the specified sender.

ApiSender_CreateSenderAsync.description: Creates a new sender account (email identity)

ApiSender_DeleteSenderAsync.description: Deletes (deactivates) a sender email account from the current organization.

ApiSender_GetSenderByIdAsync.description: Retrieves detailed info for a sender by unique sender ID.

ApiSender_GetSendersAsync.description: Returns a paginated list of all senders (email accounts) configured for the authenticated organization with optional filtering.

ApiSender_GetSendersErrors.description: Returns error logs associated with a sender account.

ApiSender_RemoveSenderTagsAsync.displayName: Remove a specific tag from a sender
ApiSender_RemoveSenderTagsAsync.description: Removes a tag from the specified sender.

ApiSender_UpdateSenderAsync.description: Updates editable properties on an existing sender account.

ApiSequence_CreateFollowup.displayName: Creates a new follow-up in a sequence
ApiSequence_CreateFollowup.description: Creates and attaches a new follow-up to the given sequence in the authenticated organization.

ApiSequence_DeleteSequence.description: Deletes a sequence by ID for the authenticated organization and campaign (soft delete, also removes followups).

ApiSequence_GetSequenceFollowups.displayName: Retrieves all follow-ups for a specific sequence
ApiSequence_GetSequenceFollowups.description: Returns all follow-ups associated with the specified sequence for the authenticated organization.

ApiSequence_UpdateSequence.description: Updates supplied fields for a sequence owned by the authenticated organization.
